context: A screenshot of nyc-live, a 3D map of lower Manhattan centred on 598 Broadway (the red pin), rendered in a web browser. Citi Bike docks are drawn as vertical bars at their real positions: the height of a bar is the number of bikes available, classic bikes in blue with e-bikes stacked on top in green.

checks.name: dock_bars
checks.instructions: Vertical bars of different heights stand at street corners around the red pin.

checks.name: ebike_colour
checks.instructions: Several bars have an upper part in a second colour, clearly different from the colour of their lower part.
